entities.summary: Sylvain Sylvain (b. 1951-02-14, Cairo) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Cairo and United States. Known in the fields of united states, composers & musicians, americas.
